import networkx as nx

def is_k_colorable(G, k):
    # Simple backtracking to check k-colorability
    coloring = {}
    def backtrack(node):
        if node == G.number_of_nodes():
            return True
        for color in range(k):
            if all(coloring.get(neighbor) != color for neighbor in G.neighbors(node)):
                coloring[node] = color
                if backtrack(node + 1):
                    return True
                del coloring[node]
        return False
    return backtrack(0)
